svg.desc: Knowledge distillation. The same input goes to a frozen teacher and a trainable student. The teacher's logits softened by temperature T give soft targets; the student's softened logits are compared with them by a KL term weighted alpha times T squared, and the student's logits are compared with the true label by a cross-entropy term weighted one minus alpha. The two terms are summed into the loss.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The student learns from the teacher's softened probabilities and from the true label.

svg.text: L = α · T² · KL(softmax(z_t/T) ‖ softmax(z_s/T)) + (1 − α) · CE(z_s, y)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: T > 1 exposes the small probabilities (“dark knowledge”); T² keeps the soft term's gradient size independent of T.
